//regions: Run the functions in the SAME region as your MongoDB Atlas cluster.
Every page does several database round trips; putting the app in the US
and the database in Europe adds an Atlantic crossing to each one, and the
app will feel sluggish for no visible reason.
Check your cluster's region in Atlas (Database -> your cluster, under the
name), then set the matching Vercel region below:
Frankfurt is usually the best of these for Nigeria.
//crons: The daily takings summary, emailed to the owner at closing time.
Times are UTC: 19:00 UTC = 8:00pm in Lagos.
Two things this needs before it will work:
1. CRON_SECRET set in the Vercel environment variables
2. SMTP_* configured, and the owner's email set under Settings
(without SMTP it still runs, it simply has nowhere to send)
Vercel does not let a cron carry a query string, so the secret is read
from the Authorization header Vercel sends automatically.
